welcome.title: Welcome to PaneCrew
welcome.body: Multiple real terminals visible at once, side by side instead of one after another — the explorer automatically follows whichever pane you're working in.

preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.body: You can change this anytime in Settings.

permissions.title: Terminal permissions
permissions.body: If your terminal ever hits “Operation not permitted” outside your project folder, this fixes it. You can do this anytime later in Settings too.

ready.title: Ready to start
ready.body: Once two projects are open side by side, you'll see the grid in action — start by opening your first one.
ready.bodyExisting: Your open projects stay exactly as they are — carry on.

empty.title: Multiple projects, side by side
empty.body: Open your first project here to get started.

hasPanes.title: The explorer follows the active pane
hasPanes.body: Open a second project in an empty slot to see the grid in action.

ahaReached.title: This is the grid in action
ahaReached.body: You already have multiple projects open at once — the explorer automatically follows whichever pane is focused.

templateSwitcher.blockReason_one: {{active}} active panes don't fit into {{target}} ({{targetSlots}} slot).
templateSwitcher.blockReason_other: {{active}} active panes don't fit into {{target}} ({{targetSlots}} slots).

about.description: Several real terminal sessions side by side instead of one after another — a grid of live panes, plus a file explorer that always follows the currently focused pane.

settings.searchAria: Search settings by name or description

onboarding.label: Show onboarding again
onboarding.description: Shows the introduction (setup wizard and guided tour) again, as if you were starting PaneCrew for the first time.

permissions.title: Permissions (macOS)
permissions.explainer: macOS asks for extra access when a terminal command reaches outside your project folder. Full Disk Access covers that in one place:

settings.terminalRestartHint: Applies starting with the next new terminal session — the running session is unaffected.

rawJson.hint: Plain text view with no autocomplete or inline validation.
rawJson.invalidValue: Value doesn't match the expected type of “{{key}}” — not saved.

shell.label: Shell
shell.description: The program that starts a new terminal session.

fontSize.label: Font size
fontSize.description: Character size in the terminal, in pixels.

activityIdleMs.label: Idle time before "waiting for you"
activityIdleMs.description: How long a terminal tab must produce no output at all before it's flagged as done and waiting for you. Clears immediately once new output arrives or you open the tab. In milliseconds.

activityLineThreshold.label: Activity threshold (lines)
activityLineThreshold.description: Minimum number of new lines a terminal tab must produce before it's considered to have done real work at all — a freshly opened, still-empty shell won't be flagged as "waiting for you".

defaultAdapter.label: Default tool for new terminal tabs
defaultAdapter.description: What a newly opened terminal tab starts with, without picking it from the dropdown yourself. Clicking the dropdown still offers every alternative.

confirmBeforeDelete.label: Confirm before deleting
confirmBeforeDelete.description: Shows a confirmation prompt before moving a file or folder to the trash.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Controls whether PaneCrew renders light, dark, or matches the system setting.

language.label: Language
language.description: User interface language, applies immediately across all open windows.

zoom.label: UI zoom
zoom.description: Scales the whole interface (same as Shift+Cmd/Ctrl +/-/0). Does not affect terminal font size.

defaultTemplate.label: Default grid template
defaultTemplate.description: The grid layout a newly opened window starts with.

updater.restartDescription: PaneCrew will restart to install version <bold>{{version}}</bold>. Running terminal sessions will end.
updater.error: The update could not be installed.
updater.homebrewHint: Installed via Homebrew — update with “brew upgrade --cask panecrew”.
